videoTitle: Why Your Honeymoon Might Feel Wrong (Even After 12 Years Together)
videoDescription: That sudden doubt right after the wedding? Research shows post-wedding letdowns are more common than you think—and they don't mean you made a mistake. What's really happening when marriage suddenly makes everything feel different. Learn more at mindtivate.com
script: You've been together twelve years, the wedding just happened, and suddenly you're questioning everything. Turns out postnuptial sadness is more common than people admit, and it's not about your partner—it's about unmet expectations colliding with something that just became permanent, and specifically...
